statements.text: Billing-tagged tickets are assigned to the queue Billing at all hours; no routing rule depends on time of day.
Business hours are Monday to Friday 08:00-17:00 in the Europe/Berlin calendar.
Routing rules can use a business-hours condition.
The off-hours rota starts with 2 agents; billing macros follow in a later spec.
Off-hours billing tickets wait for the next weekday shift because only the Billing queue receives them.

questions.text: Should public holidays in the Europe/Berlin calendar count as off-hours for billing routing?

next_action.action: Support lead reviews this draft spec; then an engineering plan review before any configuration change.

title: Route off-hours billing tickets to a rota queue

in: A business-hours routing rule for billing-tagged tickets

out.reason: They follow in a later spec after question tagging.
The support lead keeps it in the existing scheduling tool.

proposed_change: Add an Off-hours billing queue and a billing rota group, then a routing rule that assigns billing-tagged tickets created outside the Europe/Berlin business hours to that queue. Daytime billing assignment stays as it is.

acceptance_criteria.given: a ticket tagged billing is created on Friday at 18:30 Europe/Berlin
acceptance_criteria.then: the ticket is assigned to the Off-hours billing queue

acceptance_criteria.given: a ticket tagged billing is created on Tuesday at 10:00 Europe/Berlin
acceptance_criteria.then: the ticket is assigned to the queue Billing, as today

acceptance_criteria.given: a ticket tagged billing is created on a weekday at exactly 17:00 Europe/Berlin
acceptance_criteria.then: the ticket is assigned to the Off-hours billing queue

acceptance_criteria.given: a ticket without the billing tag is created on Friday at 18:30
acceptance_criteria.then: its queue assignment is the same as before the change

testing_plan.what: Replay four fixture tickets through the helpdesk rule sandbox and compare assigned queues.
Evaluate the business-hours condition at 16:59, 17:00 and 08:00.

files.why: Rota agents who work the queue.

dependencies.title: Create the off-hours queue and rota group

rules_for_implementer: Do not change daytime billing assignment.
Use the existing Europe/Berlin business-hours calendar; do not add a second calendar.
Do not send automatic replies to customers.
rollback: Disable the off-hours routing rule; billing tickets fall back to the queue Billing. The queue and group can stay.

effort.basis: Three configuration objects in the existing helpdesk; no code.

handoff.notes: Plan review first; the helpdesk change is a configuration card on the existing engineering path.
